gap_summary: the shim performs no VC Data Model 2.0 structural validation (it only implements Data Integrity eddsa-rdfc-2022 signing/verifying) -- nearly every failure is a 'missing expected rejection of malformed input' test (bad credentialStatus/refreshService/credentialSchema/termsOfUse/evidence shape, validUntil-before-validFrom, missing type/context, malformed VP). This is a separate, complementary measurement from vc_stage1 (.github/test-suites/vc.yaml), which runs the SAME vendored fixtures directly through VC.Credential.fst's structural checker, no HTTP.

failures.title: Basic Conformance Factoidal A conforming verifier implementation MUST produce errors when non-conforming documents are detected.
failures.message: Missing expected rejection: Failed to reject malformed VP.

failures.title: Contexts Factoidal Verifiable presentations MUST include a @context property.
failures.message: Missing expected rejection: Failed to reject a VP with a missing @context.

failures.title: Contexts Factoidal Verifiable presentations: The value of the @context property MUST be an ordered set where the first item is a URL with the value https://www.w3.org/ns/credentials/v2.
failures.message: Missing expected rejection: Failed to reject a VP that has the wrong context order.

failures.title: Contexts Factoidal Verifiable Presentation `@context`: "Subsequent items in the ordered set MUST be composed of any combination of URLs and/or objects where each is processable as a JSON-LD Context."
failures.message: Missing expected rejection: Failed to reject a VP with an invalid `@context` URL.

failures.title: Types Factoidal Verifiable presentations MUST contain a type property with an associated value.
failures.message: Missing expected rejection: Failed to reject a VP without a type.

failures.title: Types Factoidal Verifiable Presentation objects MUST have a type specified.
failures.message: Missing expected rejection: Failed to reject VP missing `VerifiableCredential` type.

failures.title: Advanced Concepts Factoidal The value of the relatedResource property MUST be one or more objects of the following form:
failures.message: Missing expected rejection: Failed to reject a VC with a relatedResource as array of strings.

failures.title: Advanced Concepts Factoidal The identifier for the resource is REQUIRED and conforms to the format defined in Section 4.4 Identifiers.
failures.message: Missing expected rejection: Failed to reject a VC with a relatedResource with no `id` field.

failures.title: Advanced Concepts Factoidal The value MUST be unique among the list of related resource objects.
failures.message: Missing expected rejection: Failed to reject a VC with a relatedResource with a duplicate `id` field.

failures.title: Advanced Concepts Factoidal Each object associated with relatedResource MUST contain at least a digestSRI or a digestMultibase value.
failures.message: Missing expected rejection: Failed to reject a VC with a relatedResource with no digest info.

failures.title: Advanced Concepts Factoidal If the digest provided by the issuer does not match the digest computed for the retrieved resource, the conforming verifier implementation MUST produce an error.
failures.message: Missing expected rejection: Failed to reject a VC with a relatedResource with wrong digest.

failures.title: Algorithms Factoidal This section contains an algorithm that conforming verifier implementations MUST run when verifying a verifiable credential or a verifiable presentation.
failures.message: Missing expected rejection: Failed to reject an invalid VP.
